北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阳光正好，体感稍凉，记得添衣保暖哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny but feels a bit chilly. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天微凉，体感 8℃，注意添衣，别着凉啦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and cool, feeling like 8℃. Add layers to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 8℃，出门记得穿暖和点，别感冒咯。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels like 8℃. Remember to dress warmly when going out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云暖和，湿度高。出门记得带伞，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm with high humidity. Carry an umbrella and stay cheerful!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚，体感舒适。紫外线强，注意防晒补水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and comfortable. UV index is high, remember sun protection and hydration!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 8℃，微凉。穿件外套，暖暖的很贴心。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and feels like 8℃, a bit chilly. A jacket will keep you cozy.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光明媚，体感 7℃，微风。出门享受好天气吧！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and feels like 7℃ with a light breeze. Enjoy the nice weather!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 13℃。注意保暖，别辜负了好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels like 13℃. Stay warm and keep a good mood!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，体感 7℃，风有些凉。多穿一件，暖暖出门。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny but feels like 7℃ with some wind. Put on an extra layer before heading out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴空万里，体感 9℃，空气干燥。多喝水，滋润一下。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear and feels like 9℃, very dry. Drink plenty of water to stay hydrated.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 14℃，凉爽。注意防风，避免着凉哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels like 14℃, cool. Pay attention to wind to avoid catching a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，体感 -7℃。记得全副武装，注意防滑。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing, feels like -7℃. Bundle up completely and watch out for slippery surfaces.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -1℃。温度低，注意保暖，暖心出行。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -1℃. It's cold, so dress warmly and stay cozy.
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，体感 17℃。气候宜人，记得多喝水。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 17℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather and drink more water.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云风大，体感 9℃。风吹有点凉，小心别着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and windy, feels like 9℃. It's a bit chilly, take care not to catch a cold.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感 2℃，请注意交通安全，添衣保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy, feels like 2℃. Please drive safely and dress warmly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴朗，体感 1℃，有些冷。多穿一点，别冻着了。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny but feels like 1℃, quite cold. Dress warmly to avoid getting cold.
